skills.name: i-have-adhd
skills.author: Ayoub G. (ayghri)
skills.summary: Ten markdown rules that make replies action-first: answer in line one, numbered steps, time estimates, no preamble or closers. Opt-in via /i-have-adhd.

install.command: claude plugin marketplace add ayghri/i-have-adhd && claude plugin install i-have-adhd@i-have-adhd
install.notes: Opt-in by design: nothing changes until you type /i-have-adhd. 'stop adhd mode' turns it off.

triggering.note: 5/5 probes — fires only on explicit /i-have-adhd, stays silent otherwise, exactly its declared opt-in design

effectiveness.note: Treatment vs control: action-first line 1, numbered steps, real time estimates, tangents deferred — precisely as sold

docs_install.note: Installed first try; the activation docs ('if you did not turn it on, it is off') are a model for opt-in skills

maintenance.note: Commits and merged PRs on the day of grading; same-day frontmatter fix

safety.note: Pure markdown — no scripts, no network, no writes; nothing it can touch

skills.verdict: Does exactly what it promises, fires only when you ask, and contains nothing but 10 markdown rules — the model citizen of tiny skills.
skills.security_notes: Pure markdown plus plugin manifests: no scripts, no network calls, no file writes, no credential access. The GitHub workflows in the repo run only in the author's CI, never on your machine.
